articles.title: World Bank partners with Circle, Citi to explore stablecoins for payments
articles.snippet: The initiative builds on the World Bank’s existing blockchain platform, which aims to create more fund traceability for investments in developing countries.

articles.title: Former Robinhood Engineer Pleads Guilty to Crypto Insider Trading Scheme
articles.snippet: Huaisong Xiang admitted repeatedly trading perpetual futures on Hyperliquid using confidential Robinhood listing plans, pocketing $125,523.
